import random, sys, time, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def build_matching(nedges=22, nverts=11, cap=1, val=None, seed=0, pathlen=2):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    nodes=['v%02d'%i for i in range(nverts)]
    caps=dict((n,cap) for n in nodes)
    flows=[]; offers={}
    H=9; tmpl=bytes([1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9]); kinds='KKKQTKKKK'
    hdr=bytearray(tmpl); hdr[3]=4; hdr[4]=9
    for i in range(nedges):
        path=rng.sample(nodes,pathlen)
        fid='e%02d'%i
        flows.append(dict(id=fid,path=path,template=tmpl.hex(),kinds=kinds))
        offers[fid]=[dict(header=bytes(hdr).hex(), count=val if val else 100)]
    return dict(mode='plan',capacities=caps,flows=flows,warmup=0,pinned=[],offers=offers)

def ref_max_cardinality(req):
    R=m.parse_request(req); F=R['flows']; caps=R['caps']
    ids=sorted(F)
    ben={fid:m.flow_benefit(F[fid],R['runs'][fid],R['warmup']) for fid in F}
    best=None
    n=len(ids)
    usage={x:0 for x in caps}
    res=[(-1,-1)]
    def rec(i,v,c):
        if i==n:
            if (v,-c)>res[0]: res[0]=(v,-c)
            return
        fid=ids[i]
        feasible=True
        for nd in F[fid]['path']:
            if usage[nd]+1>caps[nd]: feasible=False;break
        if feasible:
            for nd in F[fid]['path']: usage[nd]+=1
            rec(i+1,v+ben[fid],c+1)
            for nd in F[fid]['path']: usage[nd]-=1
        rec(i+1,v,c)
    rec(0,0,0)
    return res[0]

for seed in range(6):
    req=build_matching(seed=seed, cap=1)
    st=time.time(); got=m.respond(req); el=time.time()-st
    print('seed',seed,'t=%.3f'%el, got, 'ref', ref_max_cardinality(req))
# tighter: 22 edges, 6 vertices cap 1
for seed in range(4):
    req=build_matching(seed=100+seed,nverts=6,cap=1)
    st=time.time(); got=m.respond(req); el=time.time()-st
    print('dense seed',seed,'t=%.3f'%el,got,'ref',ref_max_cardinality(req))
# equal-value, additive coincidence values
for seed in range(4):
    req=build_matching(seed=200+seed,nverts=8,cap=2,val=7)
    st=time.time(); got=m.respond(req); el=time.time()-st
    print('val7 seed',seed,'t=%.3f'%el,got,'ref',ref_max_cardinality(req))
PYEOF
